updates.claim: ad5933_get_real()/get_imaginary() cast a uint16_t to int, so negative 16-bit two's-complement results read as 32768-65535. take_measurement() averages them, so the error reaches the sweep output. AD5933 datasheet Rev F: registers are 16-bit two's complement.

updates.claim: I2C read failure in ad5933_get_real()/get_imaginary() returns 0 with no error. take_measurement() averages the 0 in, so a bus error becomes a valid-looking zero point.
